newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus Vision to add more language channels.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus Vision to add more language channels.

text.p: Pay tv operator Optus Vision said on Thursday it plans to offer a second Chinese channel to its existing Chinese Televison Network Service channel.

Optus Vision said the new channel, Central China Television, would be launched along with four other non-English channels. The launch of the four channels -- two Greek, one Arabic and a Italian channel -- was first announced last week.
The launch of these new channels would make it seven foreign language channels Optus Vision broadcasts on its cable network. It already broadcasts a Japanese language channel.
